title: Hiroshi Shimomoto's Delinquent Gacha Manga Enters Last Arc
content: Shueisha 's MANGA Plus service is releasing the manga in English, and it describes the story: Jikkai High, with a low academic score of just nine, is a bottom-tier school where delinquents from all over the country gather, with new transfer students arriving almost every week.
author: ANN

title: 2026 Is the Year of Female Anime Characters (& These 5 Prove It)
content: 2026 is reaching its halfway point, meaning many of the new and returning anime released this year have already come to an end. As a result, it is the perfect time to reflect on what the year has produced so far.
author: ComicBook

title: Stupid Never Dies Action Game Debuts in Fall
content: Osaka-based game development studio GPTrack50 revealed in a new trailer on Wednesday its Stupid Never Dies action game will launch for PlayStation 5 and PC via Steam in fall 2026. The company describes the game: Julia has frozen to death. Monsters roam the streets. How did the world end up like this…?
author: ANN

title: Over Requiemz Otome Game's Trailer Previews Opening Song
content: Aksys Games began streaming a new trailer for Idea Factory and Kogado Studio's OVER REQUIEMZ , an otome game based on The Wizard of Oz , on Tuesday. The trailer previews the game's opening theme song "Muted Expectations" by Hisano.
author: ANN

title: Digimon Story Time Stranger Game Launches Demo for Switch, Switch 2
content: Bandai Namco Entertainment America revealed via a trailer on Wednesday a playable demo for the Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 release of its Digimon Story Time Stranger game . In the video, Terriermon Assistant introduces the demo, which is available on the Nintendo eShop now.
author: ANN

title: Hiroto Ōishi Launches Akutoku no Rakuen Manga
content: This year's 28th issue of Kodansha 's Morning magazine revealed on Thursday that Hiroto Ōishi will launch a new manga titled Akutoku no Rakuen (Immoral Paradise) in the magazine's next issue on June 19. The manga will have a color opening page.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll to Resurrect Classic Anime After 30 Years
content: Throughout anime history, there have been some unique properties that found their way into the American ecosystem in the 1980s and 1990s, introducing scores of new fans to the medium. While franchises like Kingdom and Detective Conan might have hit it big in Japan, series like this don’t hit it as big in the West.
author: ComicBook

title: Captain Tsubasa 2: World Fighters Soccer Game Unveils New 'Battle of the Strongest' Trailer
content: Bandai Namco Entertainment America revealed on Wednesday a new trailer titled "Battle of the Strongest" for Captain Tsubasa 2: World Fighters , a new soccer game based on Yōichi Takahashi 's Captain Tsubasa manga.
author: ANN

title: Avatar: The Last Airbender Creator Breaks Silence on Movie Leak & Cancellation Controversy: “Big Setback”
content: One of the minds behind Avatar: The Last Airbender has broken their silence on the feature film’s leak and recent reported game cancellation, and revealed their thoughts on the state of the franchise.
author: ComicBook

title: 5 Major Shonen Jump Manga Ending in 2026 (Ranked By How Soon the Finale Hits)
content: There are some major Shonen Jump manga franchises now in various stages towards their grand finales, so it’s time to get ready for a lot of hits to come to an end end this year.
author: ComicBook
